title.zh: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model
title.en: Jamba: A Hybrid Transformer-Mamba Language Model

evidence.quote: a new base large language model based on a novel hybrid Transformer-Mamba mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture
a powerful model that fits in a single 80GB GPU
strong results for up to 256K tokens context length

notes.zh:
问题：纯 Transformer 的 KV cache 与长上下文成本高，纯 Mamba 又在部分离散任务上弱；能不能把 Transformer 与 Mamba 交错，再叠 MoE，同时保住吞吐与显存。
证据位置：摘要提出 Transformer 层与 Mamba 层交错的混合 MoE 架构，部分层加 MoE 提升容量；某个配置可放进单张 80GB GPU，在标准语言与长上下文评测上有竞争力，并给出 256K token 的结果；权重以宽松许可公开。
作者自陈局限：论文只实现并验证有限配置，层交错与专家混合方式依赖大量消融；256K 是特定评测，不是所有长上下文任务；没有独立复现与生产服务数据。
它没主张的：不是 Transformer 与 Mamba 的最优配比已定；不是单卡 80GB 就能训练同等模型；不是所有长上下文都优于纯 Transformer。
notes.en:
Problem: pure Transformers pay a large KV-cache and long-context cost, while pure Mamba can be weaker on some discrete tasks; can Transformer and Mamba layers be interleaved with MoE to keep throughput and memory.
Where the evidence sits: the abstract proposes a hybrid Transformer-Mamba MoE architecture with interleaved blocks and MoE in some layers; one configuration fits in a single 80GB GPU, is competitive on standard language and long-context evaluations and reports results up to 256K tokens; weights are released under a permissive licence.
What the authors say about limits: only a limited set of configurations is built and evaluated; interleaving and expert mixing depend on extensive ablations; 256K is a specific evaluation, not every long-context task; there is no independent reproduction or production serving data.
What it does not claim: not that the optimal Transformer/Mamba ratio is settled; not that one 80GB GPU can train an equivalent model; not that it beats pure Transformers on every long-context task.
